title: palcheck section 5 textually mirrors draw_tie_mark's ring geometry constants instead of consuming a shared proc
evidence:
harness/palcheck.odin:601-605:
		// ring geometry mirrors draw_tie_mark: r = s * 0.62, band 2.5 * scale
		slot, _ := pp.node_slot(&state.topology, n0)
		c := rnd.node_screen(&view, state.topology.node_pos[slot])
		s := view.tile_px * view.scale
		r := s * 0.62
vs app/render/assist.odin:525-526 (draw_tie_mark):
	r := s * 0.62
	th := 2.5 * v.scale
detail: The 0.62 radius and 2.5 band factors now live in two files. Drift fails loudly but confusingly, needing manual sync. palcheck already calls rnd procs (node_screen, tie_dash_on), so the mirror is a choice, not a constraint.
recommended_fix: Export the tie-ring bounds from app/render (e.g. tie_ring_geometry(v, s) -> (r_in, r_out)) and have palcheck consume it, making the scan mechanically tied to the draw.
